parameters.help_en: The identifier of the context model to delete, obtained from the request path /context-models/{name}. Only uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-) are supported. If the model does not exist, a 404 error is returned
parameters.help_zh: 待删除的上下文模型标识，取自请求路径 /context-models/{name}，仅支持大小写字母、数字、下划线（_）与短横线（-）；模型不存在时返回 404
parameters.name: name

status.description_en: The status of the call result. If the deletion is successful, success is returned. After the model is deleted, the model name can be reused for creation
status.description_zh: 调用结果状态。删除成功时固定返回 success；删除后该模型名称可再次用于创建

v1_parameters.help_en: The identifier of the context model to delete, obtained from the request path /context-models/{name}. Only uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-) are supported. If the model does not exist, a 404 error is returned
v1_parameters.help_zh: 待删除的上下文模型标识，取自请求路径 /context-models/{name}，仅支持大小写字母、数字、下划线（_）与短横线（-）；模型不存在时返回 404
v1_parameters.name: name
